text: Needs you groups its cards by repository, folds what has waited more than two days, and dims nothing (#833). With everything shown the cards ran together and another repository's were drawn at half opacity, and a five-day-old issue counted the same as today's ask, so the headline read 7 when three were new. Each repository's cards now sit under its name and count; what has waited more than two days folds under one line that opens and stays open through a redraw; the headline's chip counts what's new and says how many are stalled; and each Show choice says how many need a person there. Two days is the line because a person who hasn't acted in that long has seen it.
